clonedModelName.description: The name of the cloned {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}.

updatedPipes.description:
A list of {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModelCloningPipe}s that should be used to update the sub-pipes of the newly created
{@link MlPipeline} and {@link MlPipeline}.

approach.description:
Use this field to specify whether the keys of the {@link #approach} correspond to the `fields` on the  {@link MlPipeline}
or the `vertices` on the {@link MlPipeline}.

The default value is `fields`, which means that both the `fields` and `vertices` of the {@link MlPipeline} will be updated
with the provided {@link MlPipe}s. This corresponds to calling {@link ReliabilityRiskMl.Pipeline#replaceByFieldNames} on the
underlying pipeline. In order to use this API  on any {@link MlPipeline}, the corresponding {@link MlTemplate.Pipeline} must
provide an implementation of  the `getFieldNamesToVertexNamesMap` API on the pipeline. See {@link ReliabilityRiskMl.Pipeline}
and  {@link ReliabilityRiskMl.ReconstructionPipeline} for examples.

Set this field to `vertices` instead if you want to generate a new {@link MlPipeline} and ONLY replace the `vertices` of the
new {@link MlPipeline} with the provided {@link MlPipe}s. This will not update the `fields` of the new {@link MlPipeline},
and this option should be used carefully. This corresponds to calling {@link ReliabilityUtils#replacePipelineVertices}
on the underlying pipeline.

Note that when this field is ignored when used by `ReliabilityRiskMlModel#retrain`, where we will only replace the `fields`
of the {@link MlPipeline}, as the updated pipeline vertices will created after retraining the model.

fullOverride.description:
If set to false, the provided `updatedPipes` will clone the existing {@link MlPipeline}'s sub-pipe, and only update the
fields that are in the user provided sub-pipe. This is the default behavior. The provided `updatedPipes` should not be persisted
to the database, and the updated sub-pipes MUST be trained.

If set to true, the provided `updatedPipes` will be used to completely replace the existing @link MlPipeline} vertices with
the provided sub-pipes. The provided `updatedPipes` MUST be trained.

Note that if a sub-pipe field in the original @link MlPipeline} and the user provided sub-pipe for that field are of different
types, then for that field, this API will always perform a full override, regardless of the value of `fullOverride`.

If `fullOverride` is set to true, the user-provided `updatedPipes` must already be trained. If `fullOverride` is false, then the
user-provided `updatedPipes` need not be trained themselves, but the modified pipes after the partial override must be trained.

title: This spec is used to configure how to clone a given {@link MlPipeline}.
name: ReliabilityRiskMlModelCloningSpec
